item.description:
Downloads now use one media connection at a time. Opening the player pauses active downloads after their connection is closed; closing the player resumes only automatically paused downloads. Other downloads wait in a queue.
Completed downloads now have a confirmed Delete action that moves the original and any MP4 copy to Trash and removes the app entry. Missing files are detected when returning to Downloads or reactivating the app.
New optional Create MP4 Copy action copies compatible video/audio from a completed MKV without re-encoding. The original MKV, including subtitles, is kept. Uses the bundled FFmpeg helper and existing LGPL media runtime; no extra installation is needed.
HTTP 509 now explains provider connection/bandwidth limits without automatic retry loops. Provider limits and streams opened by other applications/devices remain outside the app's control.
Validated with 66 focused download, playback and account tests, including local HTTP pause/resume, a one-connection peak, deletion and real MP4 stream-copy tests using the signed bundled helper. No personal playlists or provider credentials are included.
Apple Silicon, macOS 14+. This owner-approved release is development-signed and unnotarized.
